title: Placement that works for you.
problem: Placement Desk works the markets, pursues quotes and returns the results, so your best producers can stay focused on clients and revenue.

steps.title: Gather and structure
steps.body: Pull account information from the submission, AMS and incoming email.

steps.title: Identify what’s missing
steps.body: Flag gaps early and request what’s needed before they delay the market.

steps.title: Assess appetite
steps.body: Check appointed markets against the account, your appetite knowledge and carrier guidelines.

steps.title: Determine markets
steps.body: Build a market plan around incumbents, alternatives and markets worth pursuing.

steps.title: Submit
steps.body: Work portals, APIs, MCP servers and underwriter email based on how each market operates.

steps.title: Follow up
steps.body: Answer questions, chase open threads and complete supplemental forms.

steps.title: Collect
steps.body: Gather quotes, indications and declinations as markets respond.

steps.title: Return
steps.body: Send the results and work record back to the producer’s inbox.

channels.title: One placement process, regardless of channel.
channels.body: Placement Desk works each market through the channel that carrier uses, whether that’s a portal, API, MCP server or underwriter email.

items.title: Web Portal
items.body: Completes forms, answers qualifying questions and retrieves quotes.

items.title: API
items.body: Connects directly where a carrier offers an API.

items.title: Email
items.body: Manages the thread, follows up and returns the response.

items.title: MCP
items.body: Calls the quoting tools a carrier exposes to AI agents over MCP.

systems.title: Works with the systems your team already uses.
systems.body: No new system of record. No second workflow for producers. Placement Desk connects to the systems where account information already lives and returns results back into the way your team works today.

links.title: Applied Epic
links.body: Placement Desk can read account information from Epic, work the placement across carrier channels, and return activity, documents and results back into Epic.

links.title: Additional Systems Integrations
links.body: Placement Desk can connect to the AMS, document repositories, inboxes and other systems involved in your placement workflow. Integration points are scoped as part of deployment.

human.title: The desk does the legwork. Your brokers do the brokering.
human.body: Placement Desk takes on the repetitive work. Your team stays responsible for the valuable work that requires licensed judgment.

items.title: Advice and recommendations
items.body: The Desk returns the quotes, market responses and record behind them. Your brokers evaluate the options and advise the client.

items.title: Client relationships
items.body: Your team spends less time on submission work and follow-up and more time with clients and prospects.

items.title: Market negotiation
items.body: Placement Desk can work submissions and routine carrier follow-up. Your brokers step in where relationships, terms, coverage strategy or negotiation require their judgment.

items.title: Validation and regulated decisions
items.body: Binding, coverage decisions and anything requiring a licensed professional remain with your team at the review points you define.

items.question: What does Placement Desk do?
items.answer: Placement Desk is a dedicated placement function staffed by AI. It gathers account information from the submission, your AMS and email, flags what’s missing, assesses appetite across your appointed markets, builds a market plan, submits to carriers and follows up. It returns quotes, indications and declinations to the producer with a record of the work.

items.question: Does Placement Desk handle renewals as well as new business?
items.answer: Yes. Placement Desk takes new business and renewals from submission through returned quotes. With Applied Epic, it can identify upcoming renewals and begin defined placement work before your team has to start it manually.

items.question: How does Placement Desk submit to carriers?
items.answer: Placement Desk works each market through the channel that carrier uses. It completes carrier portals, connects directly where a carrier offers an API, calls the quoting tools a carrier exposes to AI agents over MCP, and manages underwriter email threads, including follow-up.

items.question: Does Placement Desk bind coverage or advise clients?
items.answer: No. Binding, coverage decisions and anything requiring a licensed professional stay with your team at the review points you define. The desk returns the quotes, market responses and the record behind them, and your brokers evaluate the options and advise the client.

items.question: Do we need a new system to use Placement Desk?
items.answer: No. There is no new system of record and no second workflow for producers. Placement Desk connects to the AMS, document repositories and inboxes where account information already lives, and returns results to the producer’s inbox and, with Applied Epic, to Epic.
